features.name: Master of Intrigue
features.desc: Proficiency with the Disguise Kit, the Forgery Kit, and one Gaming Set; two languages of your choice. You can mimic the speech and accent of a creature you have heard for a minute.

features.name: Master of Tactics
features.desc: You can take the Help action as a Bonus Action; when you help an ally attack, the target can be within 30 feet of you.

features.name: Insightful Manipulator
features.desc: By observing a creature for a minute outside combat, you learn whether it is equal, superior, or inferior to you in two characteristics of your choice (Int, Wis, Cha, or level).

features.name: Misdirection
features.desc: As a Reaction, you redirect an attack aimed at you to a creature within 5 feet that is giving you cover.

features.name: Soul of Deceit
features.desc: Your thoughts can't be read; you can replace them with false ones and deceive magic that detects lies.
